summary: After a day of campaign stops, a father asks his son what he learned from each person they met.
realLife: A senator remembered riding along with his father on campaign stops where the father talked with mechanics, farmers and bankers. Afterward the father asked what the boy had learned from each. His father also said to keep your bags mentally packed, so no office is held too tightly.
gates: A parent is a candidate or officeholder on a campaign day.
weights: How much the candidate wants the child to run someday.
inGame: A candidate's campaign stops, kin ties and a child in the household could carry it.

turns.what: The child sulks and says nothing was learned.
turns.pulledBy: A bored child, a long day.
turns.writesBack: Lowers the child's interest in office.

turns.what: The question is asked at the car and forgotten.
The child names one voter only.
turns.writesBack: Adds one remembered person to the child's contacts.
